referents.why: The suffix 'my' on shepherd is first person common singular, and the psalm quotes no one else in this verse, so 'my' is the psalm's own voice.
referents.category: first person in a psalm's own voice

referents.why: The implied 'I' of 'I shall not want' is first person common singular; the psalm speaks in its own voice here, so the referent is the psalmist voice.
referents.category: first person in a psalm's own voice

groups.why: The heading names David as the writer, so the sender is David; the heading clause is the frame and the two verse clauses are its parts.
